title: Blendtec Classic 575
text:
Blendtec Classic 575. For several years, I made do with a fairly inexpensive, retro-styled Oster blender...it did a decent (not great) job at blending (I frequently enlisted it to help with my award-winning San Antonio cajeta flan cake, which took second place at our first-ever squadron baking contest), however it was not so great at crushing ice for drinks.

Three years ago, I finally splurged and bought myself a Vitamix Pro Heritage 750. I was amazed at its ability to churn out smoothies, milkshakes, nut butters, flours, as well as piping hot soups. I loved the presets and the easy cleanup (add a drop or two of dishsoap and warm water just covering the blade assembly.).

My best friend is a manager at Bed Bath and Beyond and swore by her Blendtec. So when I had the opportunity to compare the Vitamix and Blendtec side by side, I was interested in putting the Blendtec through its paces.

The exterior on the unit I received is a white plastic that will fit in well with pretty much any decor. Also, Blendtecs have a digital control panel vs. the sliders / dials on older Vitamix Models, which took a little getting used to.

The 575 has four presets and the included instruction manual (which also has Spanish instructions) includes a few starter recipes.

Noise-wise, I found this a bit louder than the Vitamix due to the more powerful motor (1,575 watts). I liked that the blender blades are blunted compared to the "ninja star" design on most blenders that result in lacerations when cleaning / drying. Also, the Blendtec does not require a tamper due to the design of the WildSide blender jar (I appreciated the paper insert that illustrates the correct stacking order for ingredients!). It does a great job with smoothies (I haven't tried the other presets yet), no chunks of unblended ingredients and I love that it has an 8-year warranty and is made in the United States. (If you want to see it in action, there's a hilarious series of Blendtec promo videos called "Will it Blend?" where they put items like iPhones (don't try this at home!!) into a Blendtec and pulverize them...)

If you are looking to add a high-performance blender to your kitchen (and it is an investment that really does pay for itself!), you would do well to consider the Blendtec Classic 575 Blender.

features: Elevate Your Blending Experience: High quality blender for smoothies, shakes, cocktail drinks, soups, crushed ice (snow cones, margaritas), juicer, ice cream maker, mixer, and self-cleaning. Our blenders are used in some of the largest smoothie shops around the world, and you can enjoy the same experience in the comfort of your own home. No tamper/plunger needed due to our patented technology which automatically pulls ingredients toward the blade, instead of spinning around in a circle.
No Chopping Prep: Save time and never need to chop, slice or dice in advance of blending. Blender jar has a vented latching lid.
Patented Blade/80% Thicker: Stainless-steel forged blade with wings for amazingly smooth blends (10x stronger than other blender blades) note Blade is not sharp blade is dull No more cuts and pokes.

Large Batches: BPA-free WildSide+ jar is a 90 ounce volume jar with 36 ounce blending capacity (wet or dry) ideal for blending beverages for 4-6 people. Self-Cleaning: Add a little soap and water your jar can clean itself in less than 1 minute.
2 Year Comprehensive Warranty: An American company, family-owned and driven to build the best quality products - without compromise. Engineered and assembled in the USA.
description: Incredible versatility and restaurant quality blending bring you the Blendtec Classic 575, the ultimate all-in-one appliance. Pre-programmed (1-touch buttons, 4-pre-programmed cycles, pulse & 5-speed manual control) easy blending cycles make it easier than ever to create smoothies, salsas, hot soups, and more. Complete control to adjust your blending at any time. Every Blendtec is professional-grade with some of the most powerful motors in the industry, one of the longest warranties in the business, shipped with the Blendtec blunt blade (10x stronger than competitor blades) delivering smooth blends without the cuts and pokes. Fashion-forward industrial designs that look great on your countertop. Blendtec offers one of the most advanced blenders you can buy. Engineered and manufactured at our Headquarters in Orem, Utah.
